text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0832 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on Prairie-wide weekend rains and cool temperatures seen conducive to crop development and lower CBOT soycomplex calls. Hedge pressure was expected to continue from Thursday. U.S. NOPA crush figure seen as supportive. November WCE canola crush profit margin rose to -17.38 Thursday from -23.49 Wednesday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3893.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 down on allied markets with Sep-Nov seen trading at $10 and hedges expected in November.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne lower on CBOT corn calls with commission short covering expected to under pin the market.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne down on spill over support from WCE barley and CBOT corn calls.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 a tonne lower on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
